lines.text: In the third month, Israel reached the Wilderness of Sinai after leaving Rephidim and camped in front of the mountain.
The LORD said that if Israel obeyed and kept His covenant, they would be a kingdom of priests.
The people were to wash their clothes, and only a long ram's horn blast would let them approach.
On the third day came thunder and lightning, and Sinai smoked like a firepot because the LORD descended in fire.
The LORD called Moses to the summit, then told him to go down and bring Hur with him.
